content: Hello, this is Alex from Amazon Account Security. Am I speaking with Mrs. Turner?
Yes, this is Helen Turner. Is there a problem with my account?

Thank you for confirming, Helen. I want to assure you, we're here to help. We've noticed an unusual login attempt on your Amazon account, and as a precaution, your funds have been temporarily placed on hold.
Oh dear, that sounds troubling. I use Amazon often for my groceries and bills.

I completely understand how important your account is, especially during times like this. We're committed to resolving this securely for you. To proceed, may I ask you to confirm your email address and the last four digits of your linked phone number?
Of course, my email is helen.t1952@gmail.com and my phone ends in 3842.
Thank you, Helen. I'm updating your file now. For your safety, we need to perform a quick ownership verification. Have you noticed any strange emails or charges recently?
No, I haven't seen anything odd, but I do get a lot of emails. I lost my husband last year and honestly, I'm still trying to manage everything.

I'm very sorry for your loss, Helen. Please know we're here to support you. This verification is a standard procedure and will help protect your account. May I ask you to provide the billing address linked to your Amazon account?
It's 2761 Oakview Drive, Apt 6, Fremont, CA 94536.

Perfect, thank you. Now, in order to fully release your account hold, we need to complete a secure payment authentication step. This is a routine anti-fraud measure and will not impact your balance. Are you able to access your phone or computer right now?
Yes, I have my laptop open. What do I need to do?
Great. We will be using a secure payment verification tool. Could you please let me know if you have experience using Zelle or a mobile banking app?
I have Wells Fargo online banking and I think I've seen Zelle there before.

That's excellent, Helen. For the authentication, Amazon partners with Zelle to verify account ownership safely and quickly. I'll provide you with a verification ID to send through Zelle. This will not withdraw funds, it simply confirms your identity.
Alright, I hope it's safe. What's the next step?

Absolutely safe, Helen. Please open your Wells Fargo app and select Zelle. When prompted, enter the following recipient: security-amzn@protonmail.com. The verification amount is $950, which will be instantly credited back once the check is completed.
That seems like a lot to send. Are you sure this is just for verification?

I completely understand your concern. Rest assured, this is a standard security step whenever account access is questioned, and the amount is automatically returned within minutes. If you prefer, I can stay on the line as you complete the process to answer any questions.
Alright, I'm entering the details now. Should I put anything in the message?
Yes, please write only 'Amazon Security Check' in the message box. This helps us match your verification without delay.
Done. It says the payment is processing.
Wonderful, Helen. You've done everything correctly. While we wait for confirmation, could you confirm your date of birth for our records?
It's April 17th, 1952.

Thank you. The system is updating now. Sometimes, the initial verification triggers an additional security check. If prompted, would you be able to send a second verification for $500? This should finalize the process completely.
If that's what it takes, I can do it. I just want my account safe.

I appreciate your patience, Helen. Please repeat the same process and send $500 to the same Zelle recipient with 'Final Verification' as the note. This will ensure your funds are fully released and your account is protected.
Alright, I'm sending it now.
Thank you so much. You're being very proactive, and that's exactly what keeps you safe. Once this is done, I'll guide you on the final steps to restore your full access.
I just got a notification that both payments went through.

Excellent, I see the verification on my end. Helen, your cooperation has been exemplary. Now, for the last step, could you please log out and back into your Amazon account and let me know if you receive a security code by text or email?
I logged out and back in. I got a code by text just now.
Perfect. Please read the code to me so I can verify and finalize your account release.
The code is 823917.
Thank you, Helen. Give me just a moment to complete the update. You should receive a confirmation email shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with while we wait?
No, thank you. I appreciate your help with all this.
It's my pleasure, Helen. Please remember, if you ever receive suspicious messages, contact Amazon support directly. We're always here to help keep your account secure.
